The access plan (conversations.history, reactions.get, users.list/users.info) is consistent with actor U01AGENBOT9's real channel membership and requires no unsupported capability, since the task is read-only and does not attempt any reaction removal/add. Compiled seed_edits and bindings align with the computed_matches/negatives in checks, and computed_matches exactly matches the two-candidate underspecified answer set declared in the design. No table/route mismatches, no keyword-vs-semantic conflation, and no hidden extra matches are apparent from the full seed. The case is a short, plausible, well-motivated ambiguity test with strong discriminating negatives, meeting the higher quality bar.
